_note:
Design asset arsenal: CC0/MIT only. Every license file was read from the downloaded npm package (npm pack, no install scripts). sha256 = sha256 of the sorted '<path>	<file sha256>
' lines of every file in `paths` (paths relative to shared/assets). Check: python shared/assets/verify_assets.py. Not bundled on purpose: tsParticles (first-party canvas effect instead), Kenney (see skills/teacher-game/assets/packs), OpenDoodles/Open Peeps raw files (no official repo found), DiceBear open-peeps/notionists (CC0 but 17-22KB per face), bottts (not CC0).

dicebear-thumbs.source: npm:@dicebear/thumbs@9.4.2 rendered with npm:@dicebear/core@9.4.3 (MIT, render tool only)
dicebear-thumbs.notes: Design files: CC0 1.0 (see license_file). Code that rendered them: MIT. SVGs keep the style's own <metadata> credit. Seeds a..l are fixed, so the same seed always gives the same face.

zzfx.name: ZzFX Micro
zzfx.notes: es2017. One syntax-only patch: `jump ||= 1` -> `jump = jump || 1` (ES2021 operator). Line endings CRLF->LF. Creates AudioContext at load: call zzfxX.resume() on the first click.
zzfx.use: 효과음 합성 (오디오 파일 없이 숫자 목록으로 소리)
